messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: service:/generate error_rate = 32% (5m window) — SLO breach detected. Incident ID: INC-20251128-43. Paging on-call: @emma. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/generate-error.

emma: Ack. Oncall here. Looking at traces and logs now. grabbing grafana -> latency + errors.

raj: On-call backup, standing by. @emma if you want me to take pages after initial triage say so. pulling tracing spans for 11:12-11:20.

mike: I pushed a config change to the backend connection pool yesterday evening (pool_size=500 -> 2000) to handle bursty load. See PR #987. Rolling that change back now if it correlates.

emma: seeing a spike of 500s with redis timeout exceptions in the logs: `redis: read timeout` and `upstream: connection reset`. Error rate coincides with increased connection usage. Not seeing CPU/GPU saturation.

mike: rollback started. `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/backend-service --to-revision=3`

deploy-bot: rollback job triggered by mike. Job ID: deploy-8843. ETA ~30s.

emma: errors dropping to 8% now. continuing to monitor. If rate keeps falling we'll call mitigation successful and start containment -> postmortem scheduling.

olivia: Customer-facing note: two enterprise customers (ACME Corp and NovaPay) reported failures in the last 15m. Support tickets created: TKT-5412, TKT-5413. Notifying account teams.

raj: Accepting handoff from @emma in 5m to watch for regressions. Also capturing traces to S3 for postmortem.

emma: confirmed rollback complete and stable. error_rate = 1.1% over 5m. Marking incident as RECOVERED. We'll still do a post-incident review to capture gap in paging/runbook.

sarah: Thanks all. Can we schedule a postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT? Need owner and high-level agenda (timeline, root cause, action items, customer impact, monitoring fixes).

emma: I'll own the postmortem. Creating doc now and will invite folks. Draft agenda in doc: timeline, RCA, mitigation timeline, action items + owners, timeline for fixes. Link: https://redwood/docs/incidents/INC-20251128-43-pm

tom: Proposed immediate action items (short-form):
1) Add an automated rollback safeguard: promote deploy canary + step down if backend connection error rate > 2% within 10m.
2) Add redis eviction/timeout alert and dashboard.
3) Tune paging rules: don't page on transient warnings <5m unless error_rate > 20% or customer-impact label present.
4) Add unit/integration test that simulates connection pool exhaustion in staging.
5) Update runbook with explicit steps for this class of failures and owners.

emma: I'll open tickets for each and link them in the postmortem. Assigning prelim owners: (1) eng-runtime (tom), (2) eng-ml (raj), (3) eng-sre (sarah), (4) eng-platform (mike), (5) product (olivia).

emma: quick proposal for alert rule change (will put in PR):
```yaml
# current rule: pages on error_rate > 5% for 5m
- alert: service.error_rate.p1
  expr: sum(rate(service_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(service_requests_total[5m])) > 0.05
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page

# new proposal: only page if sustained or high-severity
- alert: service.error_rate.p1
  expr: (sum(rate(service_errors_total[10m])) / sum(rate(service_requests_total[10m])) > 0.05) or (sum(rate(service_errors_total[1m])) / sum(rate(service_requests_total[1m])) > 0.20)
  for: 0m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

raj: +1 to that. We should also add a short-circuit label for `customer_impact=true` to always page if set by support/monitoring.

olivia: Also recommend updating PagerDuty rules: only escalate to phone for `severity: page` + `customer_impact=true` OR sustained >20% for any customer tier. This reduces noise for transient infra blips.

sarah: For SLOs: propose we create a secondary SLO for enterprise customers (95th percentile error budget) and a separate alert to the accounts team if that subset is impacted.

mike: I'll open PRs for the alert rule and PD policy. Will link them in the postmortem and target merge by EOD + staging smoke tests.

emma: action items created in tracker: INC-43-A1..A5. Links: https://redwood/boards/INC-43. Owners and due dates added.

tom: small follow-up: add a synthetic check that exercises the redis/cache path every 2m and alerts on increased latency. That should give early warning before error rate spikes.

emma: noted. I'll add that as A6.

olivia: I'll draft a short customer incident summary for the affected accounts and coordinate with support to send messages once postmortem is ready.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20251128-43 marked RECOVERED by emma. Postmortem scheduled: 2025-11-29 10:00 PT.

emma: Thanks everyone. We'll review the RCA + action items tomorrow. If anyone sees regression before then ping the incidents channel and escalate. :thumbsup:
